_meta.description: NutriCare food database — expanded coverage ~200 foods, per 100g edible portion. Values are educational approximations compiled from IFCT 2017 and USDA FoodData Central. Prepared dishes marked approximate. Not for clinical use. See data/SOURCES.md for full provenance.
_meta.dietary_policy: lacto-vegetarian default: eggs classified as non-vegetarian; vegan excludes all animal products; dietary booleans explicit per food
_meta.allergen_policy: explicit allergen lists per food; missing/ambiguous => exclude from recommendations when allergy cannot be ruled out (see insights.py)
